The explanations for changes (e.g., higher depreciation due to asset reclassification, operational efficiency improvements) are clearly linked to the reported figures. The organizational structure progresses logically from revenue to profit metrics, then to financial position changes. While there is some inherent complexity in financial reporting, all relationships between figures and their explanations are internally consistent and support the overall narrative of improved performance. No material contradictions, logical gaps, or organizational issues are present.
